title: China launches advanced open-source AI rivaling frontier models for #ChaiGPT #obiteratus #aitools
description: China released the world’s most advanced open-source AI rivaling frontier models for free. A new AI tool named Obliteratus removes large language model censorship with a single click, identifying and projecting out refusal triggers. Key AI developments this week include ChaiGPT’s Sites, which generates and hosts websites from chat prompts without coding, and Black Forest Labs’ Flux3, a model syncing image, video, and audio clips up to 20 seconds. Alibaba previewed Gwen3.8 Max, a 2.4 trillion parameter multimodal model second only to Anthropic’s top AI. BlockOpenSource introduced a serverless AI-human collaboration platform called BaaS, operating on a decentralized protocol. Anthropic also launched Claude Opus 5, delivering near-frontier intelligence at half the price with new benchmarks in coding and knowledge tasks. These innovations reflect rapid progress in AI multimodal capabilities, democratizing access, and enhancing customization while addressing censorship challenges. #openai #obliteratus #chaiGPT #blackforestlabs #flux3 #alibabaAI #gwen38max #blockopensource #BaaS #anthropic #claudeopus5 #AIinnovation #multimodalAI #AIdemocratization #LLMcensorship
